findings.text: Extend Makefile cross-platform stamp to cover /opt/playwright-browsers (mismatched Playwright browser revisions cause harness crashes — 1208 expected, 1223 installed). CLAUDE.md flags node_modules drift but not browser binaries.
Drop playwright.config.ts retries to 0 unconditionally after epic-mls-live-delivery-race's 50-run baseline

Add schema-parity regression test for mls-trace TraceEvent union (src/marmot/mls-trace.ts vs e2e/fixtures/mls-trace-classify.ts copy). Filter field drift already present (Filter vs unknown) but harmless today; no test catches future divergence.

Board.tsx renders data-column={status} in both the mobile panel (line 264) and the desktop grid (line 305), so every e2e [data-column="..."] selector matches two elements. Specs work around this with .first() across ~13 files; the workaround relies on (a) mobile-first DOM ordering and (b) Playwright toContainText reading hidden DOM. Triage 2026-04-30 treated each match-failure as a separate test bug rather than fixing the structural duplication. Consider scoping the column marker to a viewport-stable attribute or hoisting the assertion onto a single Board-level element.
DevicesTab relay-fetch failure degrades silently to local-only device list without user warning — the catch block at DevicesTab.tsx:173-174 swallows relay errors with no visible feedback
forgetSiblingDevice swallows per-group network failures and unconditionally calls markSlotForgotten — v2 should add a durable resume path so partial failures are retryable from where they left off

MarmotProvider IDB stores keyPackageStore, groupStateStore, inviteStore are local vars inside init() closure at client.tsx:162-164 and not exported — forced S3 to use indexedDB.deleteDatabase by stable string name as a workaround; a MarmotClient.clearLocalState() upstream PR or lifted exports would remove the implicit name-coupling

forget-device.test.ts has 2 pre-existing TypeScript errors (line 388: publish mock type mismatch; line 552: isAdmin mock type mismatch) that vitest ignores but tsc --noEmit surfaces — easy cleanup to fix the mock narrowness

Deferred L3 deliberate-regression verifications (AC-S5-4, AC-A14-6, AC-C0-5, AC-S6-4, AC-S10-4) remain unexercised — make test-property runs only L1/L2; the L3 behavioral checks require a live Playwright run with relay container up

Deferred live-relay ACs in MD property spec (AC-MD-ATTACH-6, AC-MD-RUN-5, AC-MD-WC-1/2/3, AC-VAL-MD-1/2) require a live relay container and were only compilation-verified — full runtime counterexample observation and wall-clock validation remain unexercised post-merge

authenticate(page, url, slot?) slot param is a silent correctness requirement when two contexts share the same bunker URL — omitting slot causes both contexts to derive the same KP slot from the bunker pubkey, so A2 never appears as a separate leaf; this is not visible from the optional type signature alone

archive.text: epic-e2e-relay-state-isolation: per-spec docker compose restart relay auto-fixture to wipe stale kind-30443 KeyPackages between spec files.
archive.reason: Relitigates the 2026-05-01 reversal in commit 7b31ba1. The per-spec _relayReset fixture was tried, broke 'npx playwright test' for callers without the relay container up, and masked test-design bugs behind sweeping cleanups. The standing principle (feedback_e2e_relay_independence.md) is that e2e tests must pass against any relay state via within-test isolation: pinClientSlot, rotated bunker keys, Date.now() group names, clearAppState — not fixture-level resets. If a test seems to need a clean relay, the test has a bug.
